summary: Frontend-only regression for the ubuntoo-ancien prototype grafted at /ubuntoo-ancien (App.js Route /ubuntoo-ancien/*). All 6 nav pages render correctly (home, profile, groups, discussions, mentoring, impact) with the expected dark theme (.ubuntoo-ancien bg=rgb(13,17,23)) while the outer app body stays light (rgb(248,249,250)). CSS native-nesting isolation via .ubuntoo-ancien wrapper WORKS: no style leakage to /dashboard, /, or /ubuntoo (new social). Import RE'ACTIF PRO button on profile page fires POST /api/social/legacy/import-reactif-pro (200) and upgrades status from 'Membre' to 'Membre actif'. Embedded /ubuntoo-ancien/reactif-pro sub-app renders home/questionnaire/carte-identite/metiers routes. Zero JS console errors, zero 4xx/5xx network errors on any of the tested routes. Regression on /ubuntoo (new SSO social) still shows the navbar + fil.
critical_code_review_comments: UbuntooAncienApp.jsx is 2126 lines — well above the 700-line threshold. Should be split (Navigation, HomePage, ProfilePage, GroupsPage, DiscussionsPage, MentoringPage, ImpactPage, ReactifProApp) into separate files under /views/ubuntoo-ancien/pages/. Non-blocking for this iteration.

ubuntoo-ancien.css is 3581 lines with native CSS nesting under .ubuntoo-ancien. Nesting works in modern Chrome/Firefox/Safari (>= 2023) — VERIFIED runtime bg = rgb(13,17,23) inside the wrapper and rgb(248,249,250) outside. Note: production builds using a very old Autoprefixer/CRA that does NOT understand native nesting would silently break the isolation. Recommend adding a build-time postcss-nesting fallback plugin to guarantee correctness across older bundlers (not needed here as react-scripts / craco pipeline emits it correctly).

ReactifProNav (line ~1627) uses absolute link paths like '/reactif-pro/questionnaire' instead of '/ubuntoo-ancien/reactif-pro/questionnaire'. Currently harmless because the app is only ever mounted at /ubuntoo-ancien AND the internal <Routes> nested inside App relies on relative paths — but if a user manually clicks a Link with an absolute path, they'll go to the wrong URL. Consider prefixing them with '/ubuntoo-ancien' or using relative 'reactif-pro/questionnaire' strings.

The AdminGate at App.js line 289 intercepts all traffic when adminStatus is not set, so /ubuntoo-ancien is NOT public despite the review claiming 'pas de login requis'. This is only accessible AFTER the user has passed the AdminGate + logged in. If the intent is that /ubuntoo-ancien should be truly public (as a demo), add '/ubuntoo-ancien' to the publicPaths array (line 292) alongside /observatoire and /test-dclic. Currently WORKING but only for authenticated users.

HomePage.KPI test-ids ('kpi-success', 'kpi-isolation', 'kpi-satisfaction') exist ONLY on the Home page, not on the Impact page. The Impact page shows richer KPIs but does not carry those test-ids — fine, just note that the review request mentioned data-testid='main-navigation' which IS present.
The 'new-request-input' and 'post-request-btn' test-ids are inside the collapsible group detail area, not at the top-level of /groups — normal, they appear after clicking a group card.
